tldr.text: The value of animal relocations as a conservation tool could be enhanced through more rigorous testing for the appropriateness of the approach in a given case, the establishment of widely used and generally accepted criteria for judging the success or failure of relocations, and better monitoring after a relocation, as well as better financial accountability.
